title: Not functioning
body: Did not work and kept shutting down. Does not give you live updates.

title: Deceptive trial
body: Horrible App - DO NOT DOWNLOAD. I am making extraneous efforts to find a location to mail official paperwork on this issue in a sole attempt to prevent the fraud to occur for others too. The app charged me for a full year despite signing up for the trial to see if I could accomplish my desired task (spoiler alert: it can’t do what I wanted). USE A DIFFERENT TRACKER EVERYONE! I have emailed the developer twice and have not gotten a response at all. **re: their response - Apple stated the app told Apple I was not eligible for the trial. AGAIN, the app refuses to contact me back via email. Additionally - it looks like they copy and pasted the terms you can find here as they aren’t associated with the company at the address provided there.

title: Misrepresentation
body: Advertised a 3 day trial, but was billed immediately for a year!!

title: Scam
body: Tried to take advantage of the three day trial, but they not only don't give it to you...they immediately hit you with A FULL YEAR of membership. APP IS FULLY USELESS TOO. Good luck getting in touch with them or explaining anything to apple. I tried literally TWO minutes later after I saw the yearly membership fee pop up on my card and they have it set up to where you are out of luck. TOTAL SCAM AVOID

title: Total Scam
body: I thought I was getting a quick free trial only to find out a few minutes later I was charged $60. Deleted the ap immediately and requested a refund. Which no one will give me. Even though they see the ap wasn’t utilized. Super disheartening.

title: Pay Attention
body: Just like most ‘free’ apps this one sucks you in and it’s almost impossible to figure out how to cancel. I’m paying ~$30 per month

title: Pointless
body: All I wanted to do was track my son’s first flight. Right at takeoff, you tell me “unusual activity detected, try again tomorrow!” Are you kidding me. Deleting your app immediately.

title: Not useful for the practical traveler
body: I have been unable to type in my flight number “UAXXXX” and have the app locate the flight. This app has a good looking UI but it is not effective. Stick with the free version of Flight Aware if you are a traveler that needs information and doesn’t need flashy updates on your Dynamic Island (that is ultimately not helpful because the search feature does not work). Most official airline apps give you a Dynamic Island feature anyways.

title: Not working
body: Bad app, no way to cancel trial or subscription.

title: Do not try this app unless you want to pay 59.99 immediately even when it says you have a 1d trail
body: Scam, or glitch in system. Downloaded the app to try while out of the country and flights were being cancelled. It had a 1 day free trail so I thought I would give it a try. It charged my credit card immediately full price. I immediately cancelled the app in my subscriptions and replied to the email from apple to let them know and to refund my money please. No response. The following day the charge went from pending to charged in my credit card again a email from apple confirming my purchase and again I responded to the email with no reply. I then used the report a problem found at the bottom of the email and found that is where I need to request my refund. My refund was denied without any reason. The app is flawed takes your money any runs.

title: Wrong flight information
body: I purchased the app when my daughter travel from Fl to NYC I was able to monitor the flight live, but on the way the information was mixed instead of arrival was listed as departure

title: Only has some flights
body: Tried the app to see if I could get more info than flight aware but it can’t even find the flight number or a single flight between two major cities. Maybe it’s only for flights while in the air. Definitely useless.
